channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7-2026-11-10
item.description: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Luna Grill: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
item.guid: Luna Grill-Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal -2026-11-10
item.description: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers. (SoCal & Texas only) (Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)

item.title: Noodles & Company: 2 for $12 Culinary Classics Entrees for Noodles Rewards Members
item.guid: Noodles & Company-2 for $12 Culinary Classics Entrees for -2026-11-10
item.description: Friday, November 6 through Tuesday, November 10: two regular-size Culinary Classics entrees (Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Baked Mac, Gochujang Carbonara Ramen and the rest of the line) for $12 together, for Noodles Rewards members (free account). Order signed in on noodles.com or in the app and apply the reward on the cart screen; one redemption per member during the promotion. Not valid on third-party delivery, call-in or catering orders; participating locations. Stated on Noodles' own offers terms page. (November 6 to 10, 2026)

item.title: Tijuana Flats: Taco Tuesdaze: 2 Tacos + Chips + Drink for $7.99
item.guid: Tijuana Flats-Taco Tuesdaze: 2 Tacos + Chips + Drink f-2026-11-10
item.description: Every Tuesday at participating locations: two tacos, chips, and a drink for $7.99 in-store, online, or in the app - no third-party delivery, and pricing varies slightly by location. (FL & Southeast only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Yoshinoya: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
item.guid: Yoshinoya-$5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code -2026-11-10
item.description: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off). (California only only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: Taco Tuesday: $2.50 Fish or Chicken Tacos, $3 Steak or Especial Tacos
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-Taco Tuesday: $2.50 Fish or Chicken Taco-2026-11-10
item.description: Every Tuesday: the Original Fish Taco or Classic Chicken Taco for $2.50 each, the Fish Taco Especial or Classic Steak Taco for $3, and a three-shrimp-taco trio for $10.99, in the restaurant or online. Open to everyone, no account needed; prices may vary at some locations. Listed on Rubio's own weekly deals page. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Panera Bread: Free $10 Bonus Card with $50 Gift Card Purchase
item.guid: Panera Bread-Free $10 Bonus Card with $50 Gift Card P-2026-11-10
item.description: Buy $50 in Panera gift cards in a single transaction and get a free $10 bonus card redeemable January 1-31, 2027. (Through December 31, 2026)

item.title: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
item.guid: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill-Free Delivery on Every Order Through the-2026-11-10
item.description: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage. (VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX only) (Through December 31, 2026)

item.title: Playa Bowls: Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Coconut Joy or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl for Playa Rewards Members
item.guid: Playa Bowls-Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Co-2026-11-10
item.description: Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13: Playa Rewards members (free account) get a free 16 oz Playola or Sweet Cream Cold Brew with the purchase of a Chocolate Coconut Joy Bowl or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl, in the shop, on playabowls.com or in the app for pickup. One redemption per member, modifiers extra, not valid on third-party delivery; participating shops while supplies last. Stated on Playa Bowls' own current-promotions page. (East Coast only) (November 9 to 13, 2026)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with -2026-11-10
item.description: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on Moe's own homepage. (35 states (Southeast, Northeast & Midwest) only) (Through November 22, 2026)

item.title: Dierbergs: Sushi Tuesday: Select Rolls for $6
item.description: Every Tuesday, Dierbergs sells select varieties of its hand-rolled Bento sushi for $6 each (regularly $8 to $10). In store, no card or app needed, while supplies last. (St. Louis area only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-11-10
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-11-10
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Flame Broiler: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
item.guid: Flame Broiler-Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicke-2026-11-10
item.description: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage. (CA & Southwest only) (Limited time)

item.title: Nando's PERi-PERi: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
item.guid: Nando's PERi-PERi-$1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-P-2026-11-10
item.description: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant. (DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Waba Grill: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
item.guid: Waba Grill-Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini-2026-11-10
item.description: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage. (CA, AZ, NV & TX only) (Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: 2 Entrees for $16
item.description: Rubio's Rewards email offer announced on 2026-11-10: any two entrees for $16, valid over the next 14 days, free Rubio's Rewards account required. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Through November 24, 2026)

item.title: Island Fin Poke: Topping Tuesday: Free Premium Topping with Any Bowl
item.guid: Island Fin Poke-Topping Tuesday: Free Premium Topping wi-2026-11-10
item.description: Every Tuesday, pick one premium topping (avocado, kimchi, masago, surimi and more, normally an upcharge) free with any poke bowl. Ask at the counter; no app, code or account needed. (FL & Select states only) (Tuesdays only)
